def open_regular(path, dir_fd=None):
    """N7/N8: open an existing REGULAR file read-only without following a final symlink and without blocking on a
    FIFO (O_NONBLOCK; the fstat check refuses every non-regular kind); returns (fd, fstat)."""
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK | os.O_CLOEXEC, dir_fd=dir_fd)
    try:
        st = os.fstat(fd)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
            raise RuntimeError("not a regular file: %s" % path)
    except BaseException:
        os.close(fd)
        raise
    return fd, st


def read_regular_bounded(path, limit, dir_fd=None, deadline=None):
    """N7: whole-file read of a regular file of at most `limit` bytes; larger files and growth are refused.
    The original allowance is fixed before acquisition and rechecked after EOF and after the owning close."""
    end = work_deadline(deadline=deadline)
    fd, st = open_regular(path, dir_fd)
    try:
        if st.st_size > limit:
            raise RuntimeError("%s is %d bytes > limit %d" % (path, st.st_size, limit))
        parts, n = [], 0
        while True:
            deadline_check(end, "bounded metadata read")
            b = os.read(fd, min(1 << 20, limit + 1 - n))
            deadline_check(end, "bounded metadata read completion")
            if not b:

            parts.append(b)
            n += len(b)
            if n > limit:
                raise RuntimeError("%s grew beyond limit %d" % (path, limit))
        data = b"".join(parts)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    deadline_check(end, "bounded metadata read close completion")

def raw_record(purpose, path):
    """GD3: RAW_FDS entry created BEFORE a raw descriptor acquisition (one record per attempt). Fields are only
    extended, never dropped: fd (number HISTORY, never identity evidence), state, observed_identity
    ({'dev','ino','kind'} or {'unavailable': repr}), close_attempted/close_error and the transfer owner."""
    record = {"purpose": purpose, "path": path, "fd": None, "state": "opening", "observed_identity": None,
              "close_attempted": False, "close_error": None, "error": None, "transfer": None}
    RAW_FDS.append(record)
    return record


def raw_acquire(record, acquire):
    """One acquisition for a pre-registered record. OSError from the syscall proves that no descriptor was
    returned (not_acquired); any other exception leaves acquisition_uncertain (unresolved, never guessed). The
    observed (dev, ino, kind) is retained BEFORE any caller inspection; an unavailable observation is explicit,
    the descriptor then gets its one owning close and the observation failure is re-raised."""
    try:
        fd = acquire()
    except OSError as exc:
        record.update(state="not_acquired", error=repr(exc))
        raise
    except BaseException as exc:
        record.update(state="acquisition_uncertain", error=repr(exc))
        raise
    record.update(fd=fd, state="acquired")
    try:
        st = os.fstat(fd)
    except BaseException as exc:
        record["observed_identity"] = {"unavailable": repr(exc)}
        raw_close(record, propagate=False)
        raise
    record["observed_identity"] = {"dev": st.st_dev, "ino": st.st_ino, "kind": _entry_kind(st.st_mode)}
    return fd, st


def raw_close(record, propagate=True):
    """Exactly ONE owning close of a proven raw acquisition. An exception leaves close_uncertain: the number may
    already be reused, so it is never retried and the record is never forgotten. True only on a returned close."""
    if record.get("state") != "acquired" or record.get("close_attempted") is not False \
            or type(record.get("fd")) is not int:
        raise RuntimeError("raw descriptor close refused: no proven single raw owner")
    record["close_attempted"] = True
    try:
        os.close(record["fd"])
    except BaseException as exc:
        record.update(state="close_uncertain", close_error=repr(exc))
        if propagate:
            raise
        return False
    record["state"] = "closed"
    return True


def raw_record_refusals(record):
    """A RAW_FDS record is resolved ONLY with coherent evidence; every other state or shape remains owned."""
    if not isinstance(record, dict):
        return ["malformed raw descriptor record"]
    state, fd, seen = record.get("state"), record.get("fd"), record.get("observed_identity")
    if state == "not_acquired":
        if fd is None and seen is None and record.get("close_attempted") is False:
            return []
        return ["not_acquired record carries descriptor/observation/close evidence"]

def anchor_dir(path, dir_fd, name):
    """Raw directory acquisition is inventoried in RAW_FDS before os.open (GD3 raw_acquire): the observed identity
    is retained before inspection; a failed inspection or TREE transfer gets exactly one owning close; an exception
    from that close leaves close_uncertain (never retried, never forgotten). 'anchored' is resolved only while TREE
    owns exactly this descriptor and observed identity (raw_record_refusals)."""
    record = raw_record("anchor_dir", path)
    fd, st = raw_acquire(record, lambda: os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC,
                                                 dir_fd=dir_fd))
    try:
        TREE[path] = (fd, st.st_dev, st.st_ino)
        record.update(state="anchored", transfer="TREE")
    except BaseException:
        raw_close(record, propagate=False)
        raise
    return TREE[path]

def fifo_endpoint_refusals(rec):
    """I1-1/IP1-1 consumer schema shared by the RAM collector and the file sink: exact retained FIFO identity; the
    reader endpoint acquired and observed as that FIFO; the unblock endpoint either acquired, observed as that FIFO
    and recorded as the runner unblock, or explicitly never acquired (no number, no observation, no unblock).
    Missing, unavailable, numeric, truthy or contradictory evidence refuses."""
    fifo = rec.get("fifo_identity")
    if type(fifo) is not list or len(fifo) != 2 or any(type(x) is not int or x < 0 for x in fifo):
        return ["retained FIFO identity missing/malformed"]
    expected = {"dev": fifo[0], "ino": fifo[1], "kind": "fifo"}
    why = []
    if rec.get("reader_fd_acquired") is not True or not _observed(rec.get("reader_fd_observed_identity"), "fifo") \
            or rec["reader_fd_observed_identity"] != expected:
        why.append("reader endpoint acquisition/observed FIFO identity unproven")
    unblock = rec.get("unblock_fd_acquired")
    if unblock is True:
        if not _observed(rec.get("unblock_fd_observed_identity"), "fifo") \
                or rec["unblock_fd_observed_identity"] != expected or rec.get("unblocked_by_runner") is not True:
            why.append("acquired unblock endpoint lacks its observed FIFO identity/unblock record")
    elif unblock is False:
        if "unblock_fd_observed_identity" not in rec or rec["unblock_fd_observed_identity"] is not None \
                or "unblock_fd" not in rec or rec["unblock_fd"] is not None or rec.get("unblocked_by_runner") is not False:
            why.append("never-acquired unblock endpoint carries contradictory evidence")
    else:
        why.append("unblock endpoint acquisition state missing/not an exact boolean")
    return why

def remember_identity(self, item):
        """Every readable observation is retained. T1-5/GD1: a missing/invalid outer PID never drops a valid nested
        identity, and an outer/nested PID contradiction retains BOTH keys; each case records explicit census
        uncertainty. An observation without any valid PID refuses (fail closed, never silently omitted)."""
        ident = item.get("identity") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        ident = ident if isinstance(ident, dict) else None
        outer = item.get("pid") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        inner = ident.get("pid") if ident is not None else None
        outer_ok, inner_ok = type(outer) is int and outer > 0, type(inner) is int and inner > 0
        start = ident.get("start") if ident is not None else None
        if start is not None and not (isinstance(start, list) and len(start) == 2
                                      and all(type(x) is int and x >= 0 for x in start)):
            self._identity_uncertain("malformed start in identity observation for pid %r/%r" % (outer, inner))
            start = None
        keys = []
        if outer_ok and (not inner_ok or inner == outer):
            if ident is not None and "pid" in ident and not inner_ok:
                self._identity_uncertain("malformed nested pid for outer pid %s" % outer)
                start = None
            keys.append((outer, start))
        elif inner_ok and not outer_ok:
            self._identity_uncertain("missing/invalid outer pid %r; nested identity %s retained" % (outer, inner))
            keys.append((inner, start))
        elif inner_ok and outer_ok:
            self._identity_uncertain("outer pid %s contradicts nested identity pid %s; both retained" % (outer, inner))
            keys += [(inner, start), (outer, None)]
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("identity observation without any valid pid; completeness unproven")
        for pid, retained_start in keys:
            key = (pid, tuple(retained_start) if retained_start is not None else None)
            if key not in self.known_identities:
                if len(self.known_identities) >= LIST_SLOTS:
                    raise RuntimeError("persistent identity history cap exhausted; completeness unproven")
                self.known_identities[key] = dict(item, pid=pid, outer_pid=outer,
                                                  first_observed_by_epoch=item.get("observed_by_epoch"), observations=1)
            else:
                retained = self.known_identities[key]
                retained["observations"] += 1
                retained["last_observed_by_epoch"] = item.get("observed_by_epoch")
                retained["ever_unreadable"] = retained.get("ever_unreadable", False) or item.get("identity_error") is not None
            # A distinct start/unknown observation never overwrites a previous readable start for this PID.
            starts = {k[1] for k in self.known_identities if k[0] == pid and k[1] is not None}
            if len(starts) > 1:
                self._identity_uncertain("multiple retained starts for pid %s; owned census identity uncertain" % pid)

    def _identity_uncertain(self, reason):
        if reason not in self.census_uncertainty:
            self.census_uncertainty.append(reason)

def verify_sat(cnf_path, kissat_lines, label, cnf_limit, deadline=None):
    """Two independent checks of a SAT model: clause satisfaction and both PA19 definitions. I1-2: ONE allowance is
    fixed BEFORE acquisition; the CNF read is bounded by the exact expected CNF byte count with progress/completion
    fences; the single owned close always runs and the same allowance fences read/check/close completion BEFORE
    candidate publication. GD3: the open_regular acquisition record is TRANSFERRED to the wrapper (never a second
    RAW_FDS owner); a wrapper exception leaves it UNKNOWN and is never followed by a blind numeric close."""
    if type(cnf_limit) is not int or cnf_limit < 0:
        raise RuntimeError("verify_sat requires the exact expected CNF byte bound")
    end = work_deadline(SHA_SECONDS, deadline)      # original allowance, fixed BEFORE acquisition
    lits = set()
    for s in kissat_lines:
        if s.startswith("v "):
            lits.update(int(x) for x in s[2:].split() if x != "0")
    sat_all = True
    dfd, name = tree_path(cnf_path)                # N8: anchored read of the run-tree CNF
    fd, _st, record = open_regular(name, dfd, record=raw_record("verify_sat_read", cnf_path))
    try:
        deadline_check(end, "verify_sat acquisition completion")
        if _st.st_size > cnf_limit:
            raise RuntimeError("CNF exceeds its expected byte bound before verify_sat read")
    except BaseException:
        raw_close(record, propagate=False)         # still the single raw owner: one close, outcome retained
        raise
    record["state"] = "wrapper_handoff"
    try:
        f = os.fdopen(fd, "rb")
    except BaseException:
        record["state"] = "uncertain_after_wrapper_exception"     # retained, never blindly closed
        latch("raw descriptor ownership uncertain after wrapper exception: " + cnf_path)
        raise
    record.update(state="transferred_to_wrapper", transfer="file_object")
    try:
        n = 0
        while True:
            deadline_check(end, "verify_sat read progress")
            ln = f.readline(cnf_limit + 1 - n)
            deadline_check(end, "verify_sat read completion")
            if not ln:
                break
            n += len(ln)
            if n > cnf_limit:
                raise RuntimeError("CNF grew beyond its expected byte bound during verify_sat")
            if ln.startswith(b"p") or ln.startswith(b"c"):
                continue
            cl = [int(x) for x in ln.split()[:-1]]
            if not any(l in lits for l in cl):
                sat_all = False
                break
    finally:
        record["close_attempted"] = True
        try:
            f.close()
            record["state"] = "closed"
        except BaseException as exc:
            record.update(state="close_uncertain", close_error=repr(exc))
            latch("verify_sat descriptor close outcome uncertain: " + cnf_path)
            raise
    deadline_check(end, "verify_sat read/check/close completion")
